meta.name: pr-to-video
meta.description: Turn a GitHub pull request (a PR URL, owner/repo#N, or 'this PR' in a checked-out repo) into a code-change explainer video — changelog, feature reveal, fix, or refactor walkthrough built from the diff, commits, and files: the input is a code change, not a website. Not a product promo (/product-launch-video) or a no-PR topic explainer (/faceless-explainer). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成 GitHub PR 的代码讲解视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常需要向同事或客户解释代码改动
copy.tagline_en: Turn a GitHub PR into a code-change explainer video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to explain code changes to non-technical stakeholders

howto.what: 把一个 GitHub 代码合并请求(PR)变成讲解视频:自动读取这次代码改动的差异、提交和文件,设计分镜、生成配音和字幕,最后渲染成视频。
howto.when: 当用户提供 GitHub 的 PR 链接、owner/repo#N 引用,或在已检出仓库中说“这个 PR”,并要求把它做成讲解视频时触发。产品宣传或无 PR 的话题不适用。

say.text: 给这个 PR 做一个修复说明视频
say.note: 在已检出仓库中,会按当前 PR 生成分镜和配音。

say.text: 用 owner/repo#42 生成改动介绍视频
say.note: 会先读取 PR 信息,再进入分镜与渲染流程。

howto.what_en: Turn a GitHub pull request into a code-change explainer video: fetches the PR's diff, commits and files via gh, plans the storyboard and script, generates narration, captions, and credits, and renders an mp4 in code-editorial style.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user provides a GitHub PR (full URL, owner/repo#N, or 'this PR' in a checked-out repo) and asks for an explainer video; product promos or no-PR topics are not covered.

say_en.note: Fetches the PR's diff and commits via gh, then builds the explainer.

say_en.text: Make a fix-explainer for this PR
say_en.note: In a checked-out repo, it uses the current PR for storyboard and narration.

say_en.text: Generate a change-overview video for owner/repo#42
say_en.note: Reads the PR info first, then goes through storyboard and render.
